_comment: ADR-0018 §5. Copy to vault/agents/revocations.json, sign it, and put the
publisher's Ed25519 public key at vault/agents/revocations.pem.
A SIGNATURE PROVES PROVENANCE FOR EVER, including for a version now known to be
malicious. Verifying a manifest is necessary and not sufficient; this is what
A LIST THAT CANNOT BE FETCHED IS NOT AN EMPTY ONE. isRevoked() answers true,
false, or null for UNKNOWN, and every caller handles the third. The posture is a
deployment decision — CAIRN_AGENT_REVOCATION_POSTURE=strict refuses what cannot
be established, the default 'disclose' proceeds and puts revocationKnown:false
and the list's age on every decision record. Neither branch is silent.
The list is SIGNED because an unsigned one would let anyone who can write the
vault un-revoke a compromised agent by deleting a line.
versionRange: '*', an exact version, or <=x / <x / >=x / >x. A range this build
cannot parse yields UNKNOWN — not a pass (which would ignore a real revocation)
and not a fail (which would disable an agent on a typo).
